name: Institutional Exam Paper — Table Format
description: Standard university/college exam with a question table containing Q#, Text, CO, PO, (BL), Marks columns in any order. Used by BMS, VTU, Anna University, and most affiliated colleges.

name: Assignment Manual — Q-Block Paragraph Format
description: Assignment documents where questions appear as Q1./Q2./Q3. stand-alone paragraphs followed by multi-line text, then 'CO: CO1', 'BL: L4', 'Marks: 10' on separate lines. 'Assignment − I / II / III' sections become unit names.

name: Lab Manual — Experiment Block Format
description: Lab manuals where experiments appear as 'Experiment − N' / 'Experiment N' headers followed by content paragraphs and a CO | BL | Marks mini-table adjacent to each experiment.
